# ADAM - Academy of Design Arts & Media

> > Singapore's creative academy offering WSQ-certified courses in design, photography, videography, drone operation, and emerging technologies like robotics and aquaculture.

ADAM provides SkillsFuture-eligible training programs for creative professionals and enthusiasts, covering everything from smartphone photography to commercial drone piloting under CAAS regulations. The academy also offers specialized courses in aquascaping, robotics kits (Petoi), and digital media production.

## Key Topics

- WSQ Certification
- SkillsFuture Singapore
- Drone Regulations & CAAS Compliance
- Photography & Videography Training
- Smartphone Photography
- Commercial Drone Operation
- Design & Digital Media
- Petoi Robotics Kits
- Recirculating Aquaculture Systems (RAS)
- Broadcast Remote Identification (B-RID)
- Singapore Creative Education
- Drone Registration & UA Portal
- Student Portfolio Development
- Career Development in Creative Industries

## Core Programs & Courses

- [Academy of Design Arts & Media Singapore | ADAM](https://adam.edu.sg/home-2023): ADAM homepage: WSQ courses in design, photography, videography, and drones
- [About - Top Creative Academy in Singapore | ADAM](https://adam.edu.sg/about-2): About ADAM creative academy team and leadership in Singapore
- [Singapore WSQ Aquascaping course](https://adam.edu.sg/skillslab/crab-new): WSQ aquaculture training course on RAS and crab farming with SkillsFuture
- [Petoi - Top Creative Academy in Singapore | ADAM](https://adam.edu.sg/elements/products/petoi): Petoi Bittle robotics kits for Arduino and Raspberry Pi programming

## Photography & Camera Guides

- [Why Should I Enrol In A Smartphone Photography Course?](https://adam.edu.sg/why-should-i-enrol-in-a-smartphone-photography-course): Benefits of ADAM's smartphone photography course for content creators
- [Does More Megapixels Mean Better Photos? The Truth!](https://adam.edu.sg/does-more-megapixels-mean-better-photos-the-truth): Smartphone camera myths: megapixels vs sensor size and image quality
- [How to Take Artistic Self-Portraits (With Any Camera)](https://adam.edu.sg/how-to-take-artistic-self-portraits-with-any-camera): Self-portrait photography guide for creative expression and storytelling

## Drone Training & Regulations

- [Should You Buy A Drone? 6 Pros And Cons To Consider](https://adam.edu.sg/should-you-buy-a-drone-6-pros-and-cons-to-consider): Drone buying guide covering DJI, Autel, and Singapore CAAS regulations
- [Drone Sizes Explained: What You Should Know Before Buying](https://adam.edu.sg/drone-sizes-explained-what-you-should-know-before-buying): Guide to consumer vs commercial drones and CAAS Singapore regulations
- [4 Innovative Uses Of Drones In The Entertainment Industry](https://adam.edu.sg/4-innovative-uses-of-drones-in-the-entertainment-industry): Drone applications in film, LED light shows, and live entertainment

## Career & Student Resources

- [Career - Top Creative Academy in Singapore | ADAM](https://adam.edu.sg/career): Job openings for designers, copywriters, animators, and AVTF teachers
- [Portfolio Archive - Top Creative Academy in Singapore | ADAM](https://adam.edu.sg/featured_item): Student portfolio archive showcasing design, video editing, and lookbooks
